content: Solo-dev toolbox v1 scope: no high-quality direct community source found (generic scope-creep articles only, e.g. '73% of side projects never launch' claims). Best available guidance: it-tools repo structure (one folder per tool under src/tools, index.ts registry, shared UI components) is the proven solo-maintainer architecture for scaling tool count over time; ship the site skeleton + 8-12 highest-frequency tools first (JSON, timestamp, base64, url, uuid, qr, regex), add tools incrementally as each is a small isolated unit. Overengineering traps to avoid: multi-language i18n on v1, tool submission/community ecosystem, user accounts, remote sync, native app packaging. Confidence MEDIUM for repo-structure claims, LOW for v1 tool-count heuristic (practical inference, not measured).
